d:
"Hey guys,

another commission I wrote, this one for my good friend, Titan97 (https://www.furaffinity.net/user/titan97). He has been really helpfull with discussing ideas for my other stories, and I hope you will all have as much fun reading as I had writing this story. If you do, go check out his profile, he is an amazing story writer and has more raunchy stories you will definitely enjoy!
Remember, if you want a commission yourself, don't hesitate to send me a note!

Story: After Lake is woken up unvoluntarily, he tries to go back to sleep, but notices a rather large female presence is in his bedroom..." - Writer
